dedupe_keys.name: dados dos indicadores de qualidade de energia da rede basica dfd desempenho da frequencia em disturbios mensal e anual

description: ONS publishes the duration that electricity-system frequency remains within defined disturbance bands. The dictionary supplies frequency-band identifiers, reference month and duration in seconds. These aggregates support grid-performance and disturbance-frequency studies. Although the portal title says monthly and annual, the dictionary defines monthly values and a rolling twelve-month window. This aggregation differs from the separately published event-level product. Coverage is frequency bands in the national basic grid in Brazil. The catalogue lists CSV, Excel and Parquet files; files are free under the provider's CC-BY terms, with no version specified. ONS requires attribution and disclosure of changes. Data contents were not downloaded; completeness is unknown, and published values may be revised. Related ONS generation-by-plant data provide a comparison series.
